role_definitions.SAFE_FEATURE: May be used directly as model input when compatible with the selected feature profile.
role_definitions.CONDITIONAL_FEATURE: May be used only after documented normalization or profile-specific justification.
role_definitions.METADATA_ONLY: Preserve for grouping, ordering, provenance, or feature generation; do not feed directly to models.
role_definitions.USED_FOR_GROUPING_FEATURE_GENERATION: May be used to create causal temporal/behavioral features but excluded as direct input.
role_definitions.LABEL: Ground-truth label or taxonomy column.
role_definitions.LEAKAGE_RISK: Likely to encode source, identity, collection setup, label, or future information.

Destination Port.reason: Can be service semantics but may encode attack setup; allowed in in-domain, cautious in cross-domain.

Idle Mean.reason: Flow timing statistic, despite substring matching earlier leakage heuristic.

frame.time.reason: Timestamp for ordering only; not direct input.

ip.src_host.reason: Entity key for behavior construction; direct use risks identity leakage.

ip.dst_host.reason: Entity key for behavior construction; direct use risks identity leakage.

http.file_data.reason: Payload/content field can encode scenario artifacts.

http.request.full_uri.reason: URI text can encode attack labels or collection artifacts.

http.request.uri.query.reason: Query payload can directly contain attack strings.

tcp.seq.reason: Connection sequence metadata, not semantic feature for cross-dataset generalization.

saddr.reason: Source entity for behavior construction; excluded as direct input.

daddr.reason: Destination entity for behavior construction; excluded as direct input.

stime.reason: Start time for causal temporal construction.

__filename_label__.reason: Ground truth derived from traffic filename.

device_id.reason: Device grouping/domain metadata, excluded as direct model input.
